description: Use after create_invoice, once the stablecoin transfer was sent, to learn whether the plan is active. Read-only and free. Pass the invoice_id from create_invoice. Returns status: open (waiting for the exact amount), paid (the bearer token from create_invoice now works; tx_hash is set), expired (not paid in time; create a new invoice), or review (a payment needs a manual match); plus plan, network, pay_to, amount and expires_at. Payments are detected after confirmation (TRON and Solana about 1 minute, Ethereum about 15); poll at most once a minute. Docs: https://alalanet.com/skill.md.

invoice_id.description: invoice_id returned by create_invoice (not the bearer token)

name: invoice_status
title: Invoice status
